CustomField.description: The Strategy__c.Sleeve_Classification__c API value this rule governs. Held as text rather than a picklist so the rule table does not have to be redeployed in lockstep with the picklist. The reserved value Default is the fallback used for a strategy whose classification is blank or has no rule of its own.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Must match a Strategy Sleeve Classification picklist value exactly, or Default for the fallback rule.
CustomField.label: Sleeve Classification
